contracts.use: Resolve plans, seats, and plan keys before gated work.
Create a blank design file only after the user authorizes creation and a plan key is resolved.
Read a FigJam product model, section tree, node IDs, and text without changing it.
Read design-file structure and node metadata; not valid for FigJam.
Inspect current rendered pixels for visual review and readback.
Read design structure, assets, hints, and Code Connect snippets unless the user directly disables Code Connect.
Read variable definitions for a selected design node.
List added and available libraries before library-scoped search.
Search components, styles, and variables; Code Connect enrichment is on unless directly disabled.
Read the whole published component graph, properties, preferred swaps, pages, and dependencies for batch planning.
Discover unmapped published components and candidate mappings; review before saving.
Read exact component properties, variants, descendants, slots, and text references for template authoring.
Read existing mapping metadata for a component and optional label.
Save one simple or property-aware mapping only after approval; template fields create a full mapping.
Save reviewed mapping batches with node, source, label, name, and optional template data.
Create or update native design-system content incrementally, return all affected IDs, and read back each step.
Move authorized image or asset bytes across the boundary when the design requires them.
Capture a running web UI into an existing file as visual evidence when that workflow applies.
Gather current pattern evidence; never override owned product truth or authorize a mutation.
